tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 51 (meridiem inference + vocabulary round 2). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys. CONTEXT - a 65-scenario adversarial fuzz against the live stack surfaced: (a) bare unsuffixed hours are read as AM - 'around 5' anchored to 5:00 AM and offered a morning slot as the closest, which reads as nonsense to a patient wanting 5 PM; (b) common relative forms fall through to ask-for-a-date: 'a fortnight from now', 'in eleven days' (spelled numbers above ten), 'end of next month', '(the) week after that' when a context_date is present; (c) 'midnight'/'12am' clock asks were not flagged out_of_hours. BASE FILE: ./deployed-bland_gateway.py is byte-equal to production image mott-lane-50. Minimal in-style diff. THE FIX: (1) MERIDIEM INFERENCE: wherever a clock is parsed from after/before/anchor text (including the anchor= form and bare digit clocks), an hour with NO am/pm suffix resolves to the reading INSIDE the store's operating bounds (the same reference-window bounds the out_of_hours check uses): hours 1-7 bare prefer PM when the PM reading is in bounds; 8-11 bare prefer AM when in bounds; 12 bare means noon; if both readings are in bounds prefer the one nearer the middle of the day; explicit am/pm always wins. 'midnight' and '12am' parse to 00:00 and must flag out_of_hours. (2) VOCABULARY: resolve_relative_date additionally parses: 'a fortnight (from now/today)?' as today+14; spelled numbers eleven through thirty in the existing offset patterns; '(at the |the |)end of (this|next) month' as the last weekday-containing days of that month - resolve to a window from the 24th (or the last Monday if simpler) through month-end, from/to spanning it; 'the week after that'/'a week after that' when context_date is present as context_date's week plus 7 days (window Monday-Friday). (3) All prior behavior byte-stable; full suite green in ./gwtest (copy of /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW44b/gw-week-vocab-live-fix/gwtest with fixed file; >= 85 tests) plus new frozen-today tests for every form above. (4) ./proof_vocab2.py standalone offline prints: 'CASE=around-five ANCHOR=17:00', 'CASE=at-seven ANCHOR=19:00', 'CASE=nine-thirty-bare ANCHOR=09:30', 'CASE=midnight OOB=true', 'CASE=fortnight DATE=<today+14 iso>', 'CASE=eleven-days DATE=<today+11 iso>', 'CASE=week-after-that FROM=2026-08-24' (context 08/18 frozen), 'CASE=end-next-month WINDOW=true'. (5) DEBUG-GW51.md: evidence, locations, the meridiem rule table, output tails, deploy separately gated.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_vocab2.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -5 proof.out; exit 1; }; e14=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=14)).isoformat())"); e11=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=11)).isoformat())"); for c in 'CASE=around-five ANCHOR=17:00' 'CASE=at-seven ANCHOR=19:00' 'CASE=nine-thirty-bare ANCHOR=09:30' 'CASE=midnight OOB=true' "CASE=fortnight DATE=$e14" "CASE=eleven-days DATE=$e11" 'CASE=week-after-that FROM=2026-08-24' 'CASE=end-next-month WINDOW=true'; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; n=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'); [ "$n" -ge 85 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n tests"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: meridiem + vocabulary proven - $summary"
tasks.verified: Bare hours resolve to the in-hours reading, midnight flags honestly, and fortnight/spelled-offsets/end-of-month/week-after-that all parse - proven offline with the full cumulative suite green.
